name: web-app
description: User-facing web applications. Emphasizes UI/UX considerations, user flows, and frontend architecture.

custom.name: ux
custom.description: Design system, UI/UX guidelines, accessibility standards (WCAG), responsive breakpoints, and user interaction patterns

custom.name: api
custom.description: API design principles, REST/GraphQL conventions, endpoint patterns, response formats, error handling, and authentication

custom.name: deployment
custom.description: Deployment strategy, environments (dev/staging/prod), CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure requirements, and monitoring

custom.name: documentation
custom.description: User-facing documentation strategy, help content, onboarding flows, API docs for integrators, and internal developer docs

workflowEmphasis: Define clear user flows and interactions
Plan responsive design for multiple devices
Document component hierarchy and state management
Establish comprehensive documentation for users and developers
guidance.documentationFocus: User flows, UI component documentation, API reference, and end-user help content
keyConsiderations: What are the key user journeys?
How will the UI adapt to different screen sizes?
What accessibility standards must be met?
What is the performance budget for initial load?
How will the API be documented for consumers?
